vignettes_test_human.jsonl.note: Frozen public holdout. 84 rows, 23 unique scenarios (name-swapped duplicates). Human consensus, 3-4 calibrated raters each. Gate PASSED (weighted kappa 0.610, alpha 0.823). Ratified 2026-09-20.

vignettes_unique_human.jsonl.corpus: affective round-3 human annotation, name-masked collapse
vignettes_unique_human.jsonl.note: 94 distinct texts from 560 rated rows. Not the public rank set — use when one vector per scenario is required.

vignettes_*.jsonl.note: DEPRECATED as an evaluation set as of 1.4.0. 560 rows carry only 94 distinct texts, 9 scenarios leak across the train/test boundary, and attribution has zero variance. Retained for reproducing pre-1.4.0 results only. See QC_FINDINGS.md. Smoke; not admitted to the main board.

envent_*.jsonl.note: 1200 event descriptions, reader-consensus mapped onto our 17-dim schema (fairness unmapped). Adjacent human gold. Mapping onto this rubric is not yet validated with our wording — do not lead with this set. Troiano, Oberlander & Klinger (2023), CL 49(1).

annotation/pilot_model_annotations.json.note: 20-vignette pilot rated by a model, NOT human gold and never to be merged into one.

vignettes_diagnostic.jsonl.note: 94 distinct scenarios behind vignettes_*, generator priors averaged. Diagnostic probe, NOT gold. status=smoke.

note: per-file provenance. Headline eval is vignettes_test_human.jsonl. Generator-prior vignettes_* are smoke. enVENT mapping is not yet validated against this rubric.
